title: Shared hazard values
description: The file game/tuning/hazards.json: values every hazard shares, read in both run modes. The file must exist; every field is optional, and a field left out keeps its default from core.drifters.base (DEFAULT_REHIT_COOLDOWN_TICKS 180, DEFAULT_REHIT_DIM 0.75, DEFAULT_TELEGRAPH_MIN_TICKS 45, and from DRA-117 GRAZE_MARGIN). {} is a valid file. Key names are the GDD's (05-lives-and-damage.md, Values; 07-drifters.md, Values; 06-scoring.md, Values). Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app/tuning-loader.md) into core.drifters.tuning.HazardRules. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/drifters/shared/base.md, Rules (Re-hit cooldown, Timers, Graze zone).

rehit_cooldown.description: Ticks the hazard that took a life can't hit the ship again. Never scales with level. Default 180 (05-lives-and-damage.md, rehit_cooldown, guess). Maps to HazardRules.rehit_cooldown_ticks.

rehit_dim.description: Share of normal brightness a hazard is drawn at during its re-hit cooldown. 1 means no dimming. Default 0.75 (05-lives-and-damage.md, rehit_dim, guess). Maps to HazardRules.rehit_dim.

telegraph_min.description: Shortest a telegraph may get once Timer x has scaled it, ticks. A scaled telegraph below it is raised to it. Default 45 (07-drifters.md, telegraph_min, locked). DRA-47. Maps to HazardRules.telegraph_min_ticks.

graze_margin.description: Px every hazard's graze zone grows each of its hitbox shapes by, on every side. Never scales with level. Default: GRAZE_MARGIN, the GDD's 06-scoring.md, graze_margin (locked). DRA-117. An int or a float, never a bool. Maps to HazardRules.graze_margin.
